title: Trellis protocol-facing changelog entry
description: Schema for changelog/entries.json (issue #126). Every entry documents one protocol-facing change: a storage layout change, a schema version bump, an event topic/payload change, or anything else that changes what an on-chain caller or an indexer observes. Purely internal changes (refactors, doc fixes, test-only additions) do not get an entry here — see docs/CHANGELOG_SCHEMA.md.

version.description: The repository version this entry ships in, or "unreleased" while it is only in an open PR.

date.description: Merge date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Required even for "unreleased" entries once merged; a still-open PR omits the entry until it merges.

impact.description: breaking: an existing caller/indexer must change to keep working. compatible: additive, existing callers are unaffected. internal: protocol-adjacent but does not change observable behavior (e.g. a new opt-in module).

summary.description: One sentence: what changed, from the point of view of a caller or indexer.

migration_notes.description: What an integrator must do in response. Required and non-empty when impact is "breaking"; may be an empty string for "compatible" or "internal" entries with nothing to migrate.

issue.description: The GitHub issue this change closes, if any.

pr.description: The GitHub PR that merged this change, if any.
